name: Kyle's Bodacious Escapade
source:
The story of a man named Kyle going through life and learning some lessons the hard way. Somewhat naive, he got tricked into a game of life and death that could end up being the greatest decision of his life. 

Fight through monsters while trying to figure out the mystery behind the abnormal circumstances and maybe even a little romance.

[Edited from [url=https://onemanindiegames.itch.io/kyles-bodacious-escapade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫凯尔的男人经历了一生并通过艰难的方式吸取教训的故事。有点天真的他被骗进入了一场生死游戏，这最终可能成为他一生中最伟大的决定。

与怪物战斗，同时试图找出异常情况背后的谜团，甚至可能有一点浪漫。

[编辑自[url=https://onemanindiegames.itch.io/kyles-bodacious-escapade]itch.io[/url]]
